releaseNotes: v1.9.6: Self-update actually installs and restarts now — the manifest points at the real per-platform binaries instead of the releases page, the update aborts rather than overwriting the binary with a non-executable, and the restart no longer loses the binary path after the swap. A combo of three models across two providers reaches its third model instead of surfacing the second model's 429, and the dashboard update dialog is no longer clipped to the sidebar.
